policies.name: e2e_care_course_select_allow
policies.using:
((tenant_id = ( SELECT get_auth_tenant_id() AS get_auth_tenant_id)) AND (tenant_id = ANY (ARRAY( SELECT actor_profile.tenant_id
   FROM (users actor_profile
     JOIN tenants actor_tenant ON ((actor_tenant.id = actor_profile.tenant_id)))
  WHERE ((actor_profile.id = ( SELECT auth.uid() AS uid)) AND (actor_profile.status = 'active'::text) AND (lower(btrim(actor_profile.role)) = 'admin'::text) AND (actor_tenant.status = 'active'::text) AND (actor_tenant.product_key = 'bella_preschool'::text))))))

policies.name: e2e_care_course_select_guard
policies.using:
((tenant_id = ( SELECT get_auth_tenant_id() AS get_auth_tenant_id)) AND (tenant_id = ANY (ARRAY( SELECT actor_profile.tenant_id
   FROM (users actor_profile
     JOIN tenants actor_tenant ON ((actor_tenant.id = actor_profile.tenant_id)))
  WHERE ((actor_profile.id = ( SELECT auth.uid() AS uid)) AND (actor_profile.status = 'active'::text) AND (lower(btrim(actor_profile.role)) = 'admin'::text) AND (actor_tenant.status = 'active'::text) AND (actor_tenant.product_key = 'bella_preschool'::text))))) AND (status = 'active'::text) AND (( SELECT count(*) AS count
   FROM preschool_chain_course_branch_assignments binding_count
  WHERE ((binding_count.tenant_id = edu_courses.tenant_id) AND (binding_count.course_id = edu_courses.id))) = 1) AND (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM (preschool_chain_course_branch_assignments binding
     JOIN org_units branch ON (((branch.id = binding.branch_id) AND (branch.tenant_id = binding.tenant_id))))
  WHERE ((binding.tenant_id = edu_courses.tenant_id) AND (binding.course_id = edu_courses.id) AND (branch.unit_type = 'branch'::text) AND (branch.is_active IS TRUE) AND (branch.id = ANY (ARRAY( SELECT branch_access.org_unit_id
           FROM user_org_unit_access branch_access
          WHERE ((branch_access.tenant_id = ( SELECT get_auth_tenant_id() AS get_auth_tenant_id)) AND (branch_access.user_id = ( SELECT auth.uid() AS uid))))))))))

policies.name: e2e_care_course_select_allow
policies.using:
((tenant_id = ( SELECT get_auth_tenant_id() AS get_auth_tenant_id)) AND (tenant_id = ANY (ARRAY( SELECT actor_profile.tenant_id
   FROM (users actor_profile
     JOIN tenants actor_tenant ON ((actor_tenant.id = actor_profile.tenant_id)))
  WHERE ((actor_profile.id = ( SELECT auth.uid() AS uid)) AND (actor_profile.status = 'active'::text) AND (lower(btrim(actor_profile.role)) = 'admin'::text) AND (actor_tenant.status = 'active'::text) AND (actor_tenant.product_key = 'bella_preschool'::text))))))

policies.name: e2e_care_course_select_guard
policies.using:
((tenant_id = ( SELECT get_auth_tenant_id() AS get_auth_tenant_id)) AND (tenant_id = ANY (ARRAY( SELECT actor_profile.tenant_id
   FROM (users actor_profile
     JOIN tenants actor_tenant ON ((actor_tenant.id = actor_profile.tenant_id)))
  WHERE ((actor_profile.id = ( SELECT auth.uid() AS uid)) AND (actor_profile.status = 'active'::text) AND (lower(btrim(actor_profile.role)) = 'admin'::text) AND (actor_tenant.status = 'active'::text) AND (actor_tenant.product_key = 'bella_preschool'::text))))) AND (status = 'active'::text) AND (( SELECT count(*) AS count
   FROM preschool_chain_course_branch_assignments binding_count
  WHERE ((binding_count.tenant_id = edu_courses.tenant_id) AND (binding_count.course_id = edu_courses.id))) = 1) AND (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM (preschool_chain_course_branch_assignments binding
     JOIN org_units branch ON (((branch.id = binding.branch_id) AND (branch.tenant_id = binding.tenant_id))))
  WHERE ((binding.tenant_id = edu_courses.tenant_id) AND (binding.course_id = edu_courses.id) AND (branch.unit_type = 'branch'::text) AND (branch.is_active IS TRUE) AND (branch.id = ANY (ARRAY( SELECT branch_access.org_unit_id
           FROM user_org_unit_access branch_access
          WHERE ((branch_access.tenant_id = ( SELECT get_auth_tenant_id() AS get_auth_tenant_id)) AND (branch_access.user_id = ( SELECT auth.uid() AS uid))))))))))

policies.name: e2e_care_session_insert
policies.check:
((tenant_id = ( SELECT get_auth_tenant_id() AS get_auth_tenant_id)) AND (tenant_id = ANY (ARRAY( SELECT actor_profile.tenant_id
   FROM (users actor_profile
     JOIN tenants actor_tenant ON ((actor_tenant.id = actor_profile.tenant_id)))
  WHERE ((actor_profile.id = ( SELECT auth.uid() AS uid)) AND (actor_profile.status = 'active'::text) AND (lower(btrim(actor_profile.role)) = 'admin'::text) AND (actor_tenant.status = 'active'::text) AND (actor_tenant.product_key = 'bella_preschool'::text))))) AND (date = ((statement_timestamp() AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh'::text))::date) AND (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM edu_courses eligible_course
  WHERE ((eligible_course.id = edu_daily_care_sessions.class_id) AND (eligible_course.tenant_id = edu_daily_care_sessions.tenant_id) AND (eligible_course.status = 'active'::text)))))
